# Maximum likelihood 

Testing different search algorithms (NNI, Stochastic, Ratchet) and exhaustive search or bootstrapping.


```{r benchmark_pestimate, echo=FALSE}
source("ml.R")
results_ml = NULL
n = 99
#n = 5
#pb = txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = n, style = 3)
for(i in 0:n){
  setTxtProgressBar(pb, i)
  attempt <- tryCatch({
    raw <- readLines(paste("simulations_data/simulated_traditions_22_07/sequences_", i, ".nex", sep = ""), warn = FALSE)
    # and now clean the names to avoid issues with nexus reading
    clean_raw <- gsub("ms\\_|[|]\\S*", "", raw)
    tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".nex")
    writeLines(clean_raw, tmp)
    data <- ape::read.nexus.data(tmp)
    unlink(tmp)
    data = phyDat(data, type = "USER", levels = 0:10, ambiguity=NA)
    ### Then GT, without forgetting the 0-length edge conversion
    gt_raw = readLines(con = paste("simulations_data/simulated_traditions_22_07/tree_", i, ".newick", sep = ""), warn = FALSE)
    gt <- convert_gt_internal_nodes(gt_raw)
  }, error = function(e) {
    # Print a warning showing which file failed
    message(sprintf("Skipping iteration %d due to error: %s", i, e$message))
    return(NULL)
  })
  
  # --- 2. Skip to next iteration if loading failed ---
  if (is.null(attempt)) {
    next
  }
  # Perform analyses
  dm <- dist.hamming(data)
  mm_start <- NJ(dm)
  ## Maximum likelihood PE with NNI
  fit_mk <- pml(mm_start, data = data)
  fit_opt <- optim.pml(
    fit_mk, 
    optNni = TRUE,      # Optimize topology via NNI
    optEdge = TRUE,     # Optimize branch lengths
    #optGamma = TRUE,    # Fit +G (Gamma rate variation across site variants)
    control = pml.control(trace = 0)
  )
  ## 1.2 Maximum likelihood with stochastic rearrangement (no BS)
  ## -> actually improves
  fit_mk <- pml(mm_start, data = data)
  fit_opt_stoch <- optim.pml(
    fit_mk, 
    rearrangement = "stochastic", # Replaces deterministic optNni = TRUE
    optEdge = TRUE,     # Optimize branch lengths
    #optGamma = TRUE,    # Fit +G (Gamma rate variation across site variants)
    control = pml.control(trace = 0)
  )
  
  ## 1.3 Maximum likelihood with Ratchet (no BS)
  fit_opt_ratch <- NULL # Initialize globally so Step 2.3 doesn't crash if 1.3 fails
  
  attempt <- tryCatch({
    fit_mk <- pml(mm_start, data = data)
    fit_opt_ratch <- optim.pml(
      fit_mk, 
      rearrangement = "ratchet", 
      optEdge = TRUE,     # Optimize branch lengths
      #optGamma = TRUE,    # Fit +G (Gamma rate variation across site variants)
      control = pml.control(
        trace = 0,
        tau = 1e-6 # FIXED: Active to prevent zero-length edge collapse
      )
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    # Print a warning showing which file failed
    message(sprintf("Error in ML Ratchet optimization due to error: %s", e$message))
  })
  ## 1.4 Exhaustive search
  ml_ex <- exhaustive_ml(data, ncores = 4, screen_k = 300, extra_trees = list(fit_opt$tree))

  ## Now score everything
  preds <- list(ML_NNI        = fit_opt$tree,
                ML_Stoch      = fit_opt_stoch$tree,
                ML_Ratch      = fit_opt_ratch$tree,
                ML_exhaust    = if (ml_ex$n_tied > 1) ape::consensus(ml_ex$tied_trees, p = 1) else ml_ex$best_tree
  )
  # And now results
  results_ml <- rbind(results_ml, score_methods(preds, gt, tradition = i))
  
  # save objects to disk
  #write.tree(fit_opt$tree, file=paste("ml_out/", i, ".tree", sep=""))
  
}
```

```{r}
plot_metric_boxplots(results_ml, "cid", ylab = "gRF  dissimilarity", title = "Unrooted PE trees gRF distance to GT", methods = default_methods)
```




Create the results matrix

```{r}
results_quartet = matrix(nrow = 100, 
                 ncol = 8, 
                 data = numeric(),
                 dimnames = list(
  paste("Tree_", 0:99),
  c("NJ", "MP_SC", "ML_NNI", "ML_Stoch", "ML_Ratch",
    "ML_NNI_BS", "ML_Stoch_BS", "ML_Ratch_BS")
))
results_grf = matrix(nrow = 100, 
                 ncol = 8, 
                 data = numeric(),
                 dimnames = list(
  paste("Tree_", 0:99),
   c("NJ", "MP_SC", "ML_NNI", "ML_Stoch", "ML_Ratch",
    "ML_NNI_BS", "ML_Stoch_BS", "ML_Ratch_BS")
))
```


```{r, echo=FALSE}
n = 99
pb = txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = n, style = 3)
for(i in 0:n){
  setTxtProgressBar(pb, i)
  attempt <- tryCatch({
    # Load data and gt tree
    ## load, clean, write, read each nexus file
    ### Data first
    raw <- readLines(paste("simulations_data/simulated_traditions_22_07/sequences_", i, ".nex", sep = ""), warn = FALSE)
    # create the dates vector for bayesian methods
    matches <- regmatches(raw, regexec("ms_([0-9]+)\\|([0-9]+)", raw))
    matched_matrix <- do.call(rbind, lapply(matches, function(x) if(length(x) == 3) x[2:3] else NULL))
    # Create a lookup vector: c("305" = 246, "108" = 120, ...)
    dates_vector <- setNames(as.numeric(matched_matrix[,2]), matched_matrix[,1])
    # and now clean the names to avoid issues with nexus reading
    clean_raw <- gsub("ms\\_|[|]\\S*", "", raw)
    tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".nex")
    writeLines(clean_raw, tmp)
    data <- ape::read.nexus.data(tmp)
    unlink(tmp)
    data = phyDat(data, type = "USER", levels = 0:10, ambiguity=NA)
    ### Then GT, without forgetting the 0-length edge conversion
    gt_raw = readLines(con = paste("simulations_data/simulated_traditions_22_07/tree_", i, ".newick", sep = ""), warn = FALSE)
    gt <- convert_gt_internal_nodes(gt_raw)
  }, error = function(e) {
    # Print a warning showing which file failed
    message(sprintf("Skipping iteration %d due to error: %s", i, e$message))
    return(NULL)
  })
  
  # --- 2. Skip to next iteration if loading failed ---
  if (is.null(attempt)) {
    next
  }
  # Perform analyses
  dm <- dist.hamming(data)
  treeNJ<- NJ(dm)
  mm_start <- treeNJ
  # Applying the pratchet method for maximum parsimony
  # Default, fitch + SPR
  mm_tree <- pratchet(data, start = mm_start, minit = 10, maxit = 10000, all = TRUE, trace = 0, method = "fitch", rearrangements = "SPR", perturbation = "ratchet")
  ################################
  ###### MAXIMUM LIKELIHOOD ######
  ################################
  ##### 1. FIRST, NO BOOTSTRAP ######
  
  ## 1.1 Maximum likelihood NNI (no BS)
  fit_mk <- pml(treeNJ, data = data)
  fit_opt_NNI <- optim.pml(
    fit_mk, 
    optNni = TRUE,      # Optimize topology via NNI
    optEdge = TRUE,     # Optimize branch lengths
    #optGamma = TRUE,    # Fit +G (Gamma rate variation across site variants)
    control = pml.control(trace = 0)
  )
  
  ## 1.2 Maximum likelihood with stochastic rearrangement (no BS)
  ## -> actually improves
  fit_mk <- pml(treeNJ, data = data)
  fit_opt_stoch <- optim.pml(
    fit_mk, 
    rearrangement = "stochastic", # Replaces deterministic optNni = TRUE
    optEdge = TRUE,     # Optimize branch lengths
    #optGamma = TRUE,    # Fit +G (Gamma rate variation across site variants)
    control = pml.control(trace = 0)
  )
  
  ## 1.3 Maximum likelihood with Ratchet (no BS)
  fit_opt_ratch <- NULL # Initialize globally so Step 2.3 doesn't crash if 1.3 fails
  
  attempt <- tryCatch({
    fit_mk <- pml(treeNJ, data = data)
    fit_opt_ratch <- optim.pml(
      fit_mk, 
      rearrangement = "ratchet", 
      optEdge = TRUE,     # Optimize branch lengths
      #optGamma = TRUE,    # Fit +G (Gamma rate variation across site variants)
      control = pml.control(
        trace = 0,
        tau = 1e-6 # FIXED: Active to prevent zero-length edge collapse
      )
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    # Print a warning showing which file failed
    message(sprintf("Error in ML Ratchet optimization due to error: %s", e$message))
  })
  
  ##### 2. WITH BOOTSTRAP ######
  
  ## 2.1 Maximum likelihood (NNI, but with bootstrap)
  # FIXED: Changed input from fit_opt to fit_opt_NNI
  bs_trees_nni <- bootstrap.pml(
    fit_opt_NNI, 
    bs = 1000, 
    multicore = TRUE,
    optNni = TRUE
  )
  fit_opt_NNIBS = ape::consensus(bs_trees_nni, p = 0.5)
  
  ### 2.2 Stochastic with BS
  bs_trees_stoch <- bootstrap.pml(
    fit_opt_stoch, 
    bs = 100, 
    multicore = TRUE, 
    rearrangement = "stochastic",
    control = pml.control(maxit = 5, trace = 0) # Caps the optimization loops per pseudo-replicate
  )
  fit_opt_stochbs = ape::consensus(bs_trees_stoch, p = 0.5)
  
  ### 2.3 Ratchet with BS
  # FIXED: Wrapped in an if-statement to handle potential tryCatch failures from 1.3 safely
  if (!is.null(fit_opt_ratch)) {
    bs_trees_ratchet <- bootstrap.pml(
      fit_opt_ratch, 
      bs = 100, 
      multicore = TRUE, 
      rearrangement = "ratchet",
      ratchet.par = list(iter = 5L, maxit = 10L), # Keeps the ratchet brief per pseudo-replicate
      control = pml.control(trace = 0, tau = 1e-6) # FIXED: Added tau to safeguard the bootstrap loop
    )
    fit_opt_ratchetbs = ape::consensus(bs_trees_ratchet, p = 0.5)
  } else {
    fit_opt_ratchetbs = NULL
    message("Skipped Ratchet Bootstrap because initial optimization failed.")
  }
  
  ## Maximum likelihood - gamma rate + stochastic
  ## -> does not improve over stochastic
  # fit_mk <- pml(treeNJ, data = data, k = 4)
  # fit_opt_y <- optim.pml(
  #   fit_mk, 
  #   rearrangement = "stochastic", # Replaces deterministic optNni = TRUE
  #   optEdge = TRUE,     # Optimize branch lengths
  #   optGamma = TRUE,    # Fit +G (Gamma rate variation across site variants)
  #   control = pml.control(trace = 0)
  # )
  ## Maximum likelihood -- Estimate State Frequencies, optBF
  # ## -> seems to degrade perf
  # fit_mk <- pml(treeNJ, data = data)
  # fit_opt_y <- optim.pml(
  #   fit_mk, 
  #   optNni = TRUE,      # Optimize topology via NNI
  #   optEdge = TRUE,     # Optimize branch lengths
  #   #optGamma = TRUE,    # Fit +G (Gamma rate variation across site variants)
  #   optBf = TRUE,
  #   control = pml.control(trace = 0)
  # )
  ## Maximum likelihood -- Ascertainment Bias Correction (+ASC) 
  ## -> seem to worsen the scores
  # fit_mk <- pml(treeNJ, data = data, ASC = TRUE)
  # fit_opt_y <- optim.pml(
  #   fit_mk, 
  #   optNni = TRUE,      # Optimize topology via NNI
  #   optEdge = TRUE,     # Optimize branch lengths
  #   control = pml.control(trace = 0)
  # )
  ## Maximum likelihood -- asymetric transision rates
  ## -> seems to degrade perf too
  # fit_mk <- pml(treeNJ, data = data)
  # fit_opt_z <- optim.pml(
  #   fit_mk, 
  #   optNni = TRUE,      # Optimize topology via NNI
  #   optEdge = TRUE,     # Optimize branch lengths
  #   #optGamma = TRUE,    # Fit +G (Gamma rate variation across site variants)
  #   optQ = TRUE,
  #   control = pml.control(trace = 0)
  # )
  ## Maximu likelihood -- free rate + stochastic
  ## -> does not improve over stochastic
  # fit_mk <- pml(treeNJ, data = data, k = 4, site.rate = "free_rate")
  # fit_opt_z <- optim.pml(
  #   fit_mk, 
  #   #optNni = TRUE,      # Optimize topology via NNI
  #   rearrangement = "stochastic", # Replaces deterministic optNni = TRUE
  #   optEdge = TRUE,     # Optimize branch lengths
  #   optGamma = TRUE,    # Fit +G (Gamma rate variation across site variants)
  #   control = pml.control(trace = 0)
  # )
  
  results_quartet[i+1, "NJ"] <- Quartet::QuartetDivergence(Quartet::QuartetStatus(gt, treeNJ, nTip = TRUE), similarity = FALSE)
  results_quartet[i+1, "MP_SC"] <- Quartet::QuartetDivergence(Quartet::QuartetStatus(consensus(mm_tree, p = 1), cf=gt, nTip = TRUE), similarity = FALSE)
  results_quartet[i+1, "ML_NNI"] <- Quartet::QuartetDivergence(Quartet::QuartetStatus(fit_opt_NNI$tree, cf=gt, nTip = TRUE), similarity = FALSE)
  results_quartet[i+1, "ML_Stoch"] <- Quartet::QuartetDivergence(Quartet::QuartetStatus(fit_opt_stoch$tree, cf=gt, nTip = TRUE), similarity = FALSE)
  results_quartet[i+1, "ML_Ratch"] <- Quartet::QuartetDivergence(Quartet::QuartetStatus(fit_opt_ratch$tree, cf=gt, nTip = TRUE), similarity = FALSE)
  results_quartet[i+1, "ML_NNI_BS"] <- Quartet::QuartetDivergence(Quartet::QuartetStatus(fit_opt_NNIBS, cf=gt, nTip = TRUE), similarity = FALSE)
  results_quartet[i+1, "ML_Stoch_BS"] <- Quartet::QuartetDivergence(Quartet::QuartetStatus(fit_opt_stochbs, cf=gt, nTip = TRUE), similarity = FALSE)
  results_quartet[i+1, "ML_Ratch_BS"] <- Quartet::QuartetDivergence(Quartet::QuartetStatus(fit_opt_ratchetbs, cf=gt, nTip = TRUE), similarity = FALSE)

  results_grf[i+1, "NJ"] <- TreeDist::TreeDistance(gt, treeNJ)
  results_grf[i+1, "MP_SC"] <- TreeDist::TreeDistance(consensus(mm_tree, p = 1), gt)
  results_grf[i+1, "ML_NNI"] <- mean(TreeDist::TreeDistance(fit_opt_NNI$tree, gt))
  results_grf[i+1, "ML_Stoch"] <- mean(TreeDist::TreeDistance(fit_opt_stoch$tree, gt))
  results_grf[i+1, "ML_Ratch"] <- mean(TreeDist::TreeDistance(fit_opt_ratch$tree, gt))
  results_grf[i+1, "ML_NNI_BS"] <- TreeDist::TreeDistance(fit_opt_NNIBS, gt)
  results_grf[i+1, "ML_Stoch_BS"] <- TreeDist::TreeDistance(fit_opt_stochbs, gt)
  results_grf[i+1, "ML_Ratch_BS"] <- TreeDist::TreeDistance(fit_opt_ratchetbs, gt)
}
```

```{r}
res = as.data.frame(results_quartet)
ggplot(data = res) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = "NJ", y = NJ)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = "MP (SC)", y = MP_SC)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = "ML", y = ML)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = "ML NNI", y = ML)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = "ML stochastic", y = ML_x)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = "ML ratchet", y = ML_y)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = "ML BS-NNI 50%MRC", y = ML_z)) +
  xlab("Method") +
  ylab("Quartet distance") +
  ggtitle("ML algorithms and BS benchmark", subtitle =  "Unrooted trees quartet distance to GT")
```
